servicesSummary: Qiddiya Investment company Accenture Saudi Arabia Limited entered into an agreement to develop a brand and marketing strategy for Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC) for use within domestic and international markets. In October 2023, QIC requested and approved additional work, in which Accenture Saudi Arabia would now assist in the execution of that strategy, including managing internal stakeholders, reviewing production assets, and tracking performance.
